recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If FHIR-I/CDS later define direct targetProfile or canonical handling for Incubating/Additional Resources, BR&R and CDS should revisit Citation support as new R6/R7 work rather than through this R5 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-31040 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked that ResearchStudy results be able to reference DiagnosticReport, with an amendment to include Citation as well.
initial_application: The ResearchStudy.result element was introduced by the related FHIR-30091 work, commit d5448ea900e832422a9dfa5dcaea0cd8cb30bb16 added Citation before the seed was applied, and the FHIR-31040-tagged commit 9175459a6ea354d82e8b09ca90574344bbe333d6 added DiagnosticReport. Thus the seed was applied in source history.
additional_context: R6 later changed the target set: FHIR-46095/commit bd6875188a7dcc57c2a07da5a7b8593021bf7a03 replaced EvidenceReport with Composition, and current source also includes Evidence and DocumentReference. CDS then voted to move Citation to Additional Resources/EBM-on-FHIR, FMG guidance said moved resources can no longer be directly referenced from core resources, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed Citation from core lists and ResearchStudy.result.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current ResearchStudy StructureDefinition still includes DiagnosticReport, and re-adding Citation as a direct core target would conflict with the later Additional/Incubating Resources decision.
